packageRules.description: Keep the Node 22 toolchain: do not pin engines.node, it must stay compatible with CI (.github/actions/setup) and Vercel
Keep .nvmrc on the Node 22 range used by CI and Vercel
Hold TypeScript at v6: v7 is the native rewrite and packages/ui/scripts/build-registry.mjs uses the TS compiler API (ts.ScriptTarget) that v7 removes
